matcher.tip_desc: Auto-matcher based on name+brand similarity handles most cases. Use this page when the product exists on 2-3 sites, but names differ enough that matcher missed it. One “Link” click creates a manual Match (is_manual=True), and auto-matcher will not touch it again.

Skip all {count} clusters on this page?
You can restore them later with “Reset”.

Click “Link” on the right match and its price will be added to comparison. A green “exact match” mark means it is safe to link.
